locked_baseline: 6v6 isometric free movement after formation, AI normal skills and manual ultimate, no time limit

ground.coordinates: world x,y in [0,12]x[0,8], tile center i+0.5,j+0.5; screen projection only
ground.cell_occupancy: not turn-based; multiple bodies per tile only if no overlap
ground.terrain: grid for walkability/cost, obstacles + dynamic walls, continuous path following, local separation and swept collision; no clipping or teleport without valid landing

shape_library.rule: one valid target; range measured center distance minus target radius
circle centered on caster at release
circle centered on target snapshot at release
locked ground point at cast; dodgeable
fixed origin and direction; swept capsule; width total
sector angle in degrees and range
fixed path hits first valid body/wall
travel trajectory then AoE at impact
persistent world-space zone, interval, expiry, hit budget
swept displacement then hit at contact
owned mark with safe landing and expiry
safe free spawn location, cap and TTL

ai.target_score: role+threat+distance+vulnerability+mark; stable UID tie break; retain target until invalid or clearly better
ai.movement: melee seeks adjacent slot, ranged holds desired range, healer stays behind, retreat if threatened; no forced pileup
ai.ultimate: player click queues eligible manual skill, AI chooses target/point and telegraph; no default player auto ult

hit_rules.target_lock: UID; cancel if invalid before release, no silent retarget
hit_rules.projectile: fixed start/dir/speed, swept collision, no homing unless explicit
hit_rules.aoe: intersect target hurt circle, deterministic distance then UID cap
hit_rules.multi_hit: total coefficient apportioned over declared hits; dedupe by cast_id/target_uid/hit_index
hit_rules.zones: fixed world shape, ticks interval, no unlimited recursion
hit_rules.vfx: same origin, shape, facing, release and impact as simulation; never determines hit
